subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Parts of my body that I cannot see: lungs and heart (inquiry process)

show.line: Inside you there is a heart that beats and lungs that breathe. Ba-dum, ba-dum!

rounds.prompt: Where does food go after you swallow?
The bones inside you are called your...?

rounds.story: Kopano runs fast. Then he puts his hand on his chest. Ba-dum, ba-dum! What does he feel?
rounds.praise: His heart beats fast after running!

hints: Heart pumps. Lungs breathe. Brain thinks.
We cannot see them but they work all day.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will breathe in.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Air goes into my lungs.

parent_line: Knows the heart, lungs, stomach, brain and skeleton and what they do.
